sources.name: Koto original editorial content
requirements: Record the responsible editorial review.
Pass naturalness, register, social-use, and difficulty review.

sources.name: JMdict Japanese/English Dictionary
requirements: Preserve EDRDG attribution and source identifiers.
Treat exp-tagged entries as candidates rather than automatically verified families.
Deduplicate variants and complete Koto-specific editorial fields.
Refresh from the current JMdict source at least monthly while JMdict-derived data remains in use.

sources.name: Tatoeba
requirements: Verify the licence and attribution of every selected sentence.
Review contributor examples for naturalness and contextual suitability.
Do not infer expression difficulty from sentence availability.

sources.name: NHK WORLD-JAPAN Easy Japanese
requirements: Use only to corroborate naturalness and social use.
Do not import or redistribute lesson text, audio, or artwork.

sources.name: Agency for Cultural Affairs — Keigo no Shishin
requirements: Use as an authoritative reference for honorific-language analysis.
Do not treat the publication as an unrestricted expression dataset.

sources.name: The Japan Foundation — Irodori: Japanese for Life in Japan
requirements: Use only for record-level corroboration of naturalness, social use, register, and communicative context.
Do not bulk-extract, copy, or redistribute lesson text, exercises, audio, illustrations, or layouts.
Write Koto explanations and examples independently.

sources.name: The Japan Foundation Japanese-language teaching references
requirements: Use only for record-level corroboration of Japanese form, meaning, register, or communicative use.
Do not bulk-extract or redistribute teaching text, examples, audio, images, or layouts.
Write Koto explanations and examples independently.

sources.name: Kotobank Japanese dictionary portal
requirements: Record the exact entry URL and use it only to corroborate meaning, reading, idiomaticity, or usage distinctions.
Do not copy or redistribute dictionary definitions, examples, or underlying publisher content.
Write Koto explanations and examples independently.

excludedBulkSources.reason: Copyrighted teaching material is not an unrestricted bulk dataset.
Educational-use terms do not authorize unrestricted bulk redistribution.
JLPT does not publish official post-2010 vocabulary, grammar, or expression item lists.
